modules.purpose: Mode-2 (scheduled) horizon-scoped budget: defines ByzantineBoundedFrom H n bad, proves the validator-agnostic top-window contraction horizon_shared_prefix (pigeonhole at the trailing matured window u = tip.slot+1-n of the LOWER tip, then same_block_same_prefix drags agreement down to any n-deep height), and re-states the scheduled light-client headlines (full validator + core validator twins, agreement / membership / genesis forms) consuming only ByzantineBoundedFrom H with H + n <= tip.slot + 1 and NO shared-genesis hypothesis. Purely combinatorial: no new model, same SchedUnforgeable / SchedCoreUnforgeable surfaces.

defs.name: ByzantineBoundedFrom
defs.signature: def ByzantineBoundedFrom (H n : Nat) (bad : ByzantineSlots) : Prop := ∀ u, H ≤ u → (badSlotsIn bad u n).card ≤ maxByzantine n
defs.meaning: Byzantine budget required only of n-windows [u,u+n) with u ≥ H (one-sided horizon: later windows, including future ones, remain budgeted; windows below H unconstrained).

defs.name: exists_honest_shared_slot_at
defs.signature: private theorem exists_honest_shared_slot_at {n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {bad : ByzantineSlots} {u : Nat} (hBudgetU : (badSlotsIn bad u n).card ≤ maxByzantine n) {S S' : Finset Nat} (hS : S ⊆ Finset.Ico u (u + n)) (hS' : S' ⊆ Finset.Ico u (u + n)) (hCard : quorum n ≤ S.card) (hCard' : quorum n ≤ S'.card) : ∃ s, s ∈ S ∧ s ∈ S' ∧ ¬ bad s
defs.meaning: Single-window pigeonhole (2q > n + f): budget consumed at exactly window u. PRIVATE — a new module cannot import it; it must copy it (both this file and KeyStealingHorizonCore.lean carry identical private copies) or call the public global-budget exists_honest_shared_slot (Safety.lean:45).

defs.name: slot_gap_of_position_gap
defs.signature: private theorem slot_gap_of_position_gap {c : Chain} (hS : StrictSlots c) : ∀ (d p : Nat) {X Y : Block}, blockAt? c p = some X → blockAt? c (p + d) = some Y → X.slot + d ≤ Y.slot
defs.meaning: Along a strict-slot chain, d positions apart ⇒ at least d slots apart. PRIVATE — must be copied if a new module needs it.

theorems.name: byzantineBoundedFrom_of_bounded
theorems.conclusion: ByzantineBoundedFrom H n bad (for any H)
theorems.notes: fun u _ => h u. The global budget delivers every horizon budget; horizon theorems strictly generalize global-budget ones.

theorems.name: horizon_shared_prefix
hypotheses: hBudgetU : (badSlotsIn bad (tip.slot + 1 - n) n).card ≤ maxByzantine n
theorems.conclusion: ∃ P : Block, blockAt? c k = some P ∧ blockAt? c' k = some P
theorems.notes: THE validator-agnostic horizon core (mode-agnostic: consumes only model-level predicates over a SlotRecord, so any mode can call it). Budget consumed at the SINGLE window u = tip.slot + 1 - n of the LOWER-tipped chain c (hle orders the tips; the caller must case-split Nat.le_total and swap arguments). Proof: hDense at both tips gives quorum on [u,u+n) in both chains (matured because tip.slot ≤ tip'.slot); exists_honest_shared_slot_at gives shared honest slot s; hHonest s gives B₁ = B₂; SequentialHeights gives k₁ = k₂; height_gt_of_slot_gt gives k < k₁ (B.slot + n ≤ tip.slot via slot_gap_of_position_gap so B.slot < u ≤ s); same_block_same_prefix hId hRec hRec' hPL hPL' finishes. No genesis assumed; no window below u touched.

modules.purpose: The timed theft layer for the flagship schedule (fun s => s / R): time-stamps theft (stolenAt i j r) and projects it to the timeless Stolen via stolenOf; formalizes A3 (NoPrematureTheft), A3-mint-side (NoPrematureMint), B2 (ErasureTimed); derives backward theft-locality (theft_is_recent), the recent-theft census (recentTheftProducers), and the timed I3 horizon_budget_of_timed which DERIVES the ByzantineBoundedFrom H budget the ScheduleHorizon theorems consume from a rent rate + recent-theft census rate; bounded forward-stamping; PackageATimed / PackageBTimed structures delivering the horizon light-client conclusion end to end.

defs.name: stolenOf
defs.signature: def stolenOf (stolenAt : Nat → Nat → Nat → Prop) (i j : Nat) : Prop := ∃ r, stolenAt i j r
defs.meaning: Timeless projection of the time-stamped theft relation; this is the `Stolen` every scheduled theorem consumes (`Stolen := stolenOf stolenAt`).

defs.name: NoPrematureTheft
defs.signature: def NoPrematureTheft (R : Nat) (stolenAt : Nat → Nat → Nat → Prop) : Prop := ∀ i j r, stolenAt i j r → j * R ≤ r
defs.meaning: A3, timed: generation-j key stealable only from its provisioning slot j*R on.

defs.name: ErasureTimed
defs.signature: def ErasureTimed (R : Nat) (stolenAt : Nat → Nat → Nat → Prop) : Prop := ∀ i j r, stolenAt i j r → r < (j + 1) * R
defs.meaning: B2, timed: generation j not stealable after its era boundary (j+1)*R.

defs.name: recentTheftProducers
defs.signature: noncomputable def recentTheftProducers (n R : Nat) (stolenAt : Nat → Nat → Nat → Prop) (u : Nat) : Finset Nat := (Finset.range n).filter (fun i => ∃ j r, u / R ≤ j ∧ stolenAt i j r ∧ u < r + R)
defs.meaning: Recent-theft census of window u: producers i < n hit by a theft of a generation ≥ u/R at a real slot r with u < r + R. Future-inclusive (any later r counts). Needs `open Classical` (file has it at line 81) for the filter's decidability.

defs.name: NoPrematureMint
defs.signature: def NoPrematureMint (R : Nat) (log : TimedLog) : Prop := ∀ r, ∀ B ∈ log r, B.keyIndex * R ≤ r
defs.meaning: A3 mint-side: no signature under generation j appears in the real-time log before j*R. TimedLog := Nat → Finset Block (Definitions.lean:694).

defs.name: PackageATimed
defs.signature: structure PackageATimed (n R H : Nat) {Sig sk pk : Type} (ops : SigOps Sig sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (rented : ByzantineSlots) (stolenAt : Nat → Nat → Nat → Prop) (honestSigned : Nat → Nat → Option Block) (now Δ : Nat) (G : Block) (Rrent T : Nat) : Prop where unforgeable : SchedCoreUnforgeable n (fun s => s / R) ops registry rented (stolenOf stolenAt) honestSigned now Δ; hashInj : SignedHashInjective (SignedDeclared n ops registry) G; notBefore : NoPrematureTheft R stolenAt; rentBound : ∀ u, H ≤ u → (badSlotsIn rented u n).card ≤ Rrent; recentTheftBound : ∀ u, H ≤ u → (recentTheftProducers n R stolenAt u).card ≤ T; budget_le : Rrent + T ≤ maxByzantine n
defs.meaning: Package A with temporal content: schedule pinned to s / R, Stolen := stolenOf stolenAt, A3 as field notBefore, rates horizon-scoped (H ≤ u) and theft-time-pinned. Compare PackageA (KeyStealingScheduleBudget.lean:204): fields unforgeable, hashInj, rentBound (∀ u, no H), exposedBound (exposedProducersSched, no H), budget_le.

defs.name: PackageBTimed
defs.signature: structure PackageBTimed (n R H : Nat) {Sig sk pk : Type} (ops : SigOps Sig sk pk) (registry : KeyRegistry pk) (rented : ByzantineSlots) (stolenAt : Nat → Nat → Nat → Prop) (honestSigned : Nat → Nat → Option Block) (now Δ : Nat) (G : Block) (Rrent T : Nat) extends PackageATimed n R H ops registry rented stolenAt honestSigned now Δ G Rrent T : Prop where notAfter : ErasureTimed R stolenAt
defs.meaning: Package B timed = A timed + erasure field notAfter (documentary; consumed by no safety proof). Access parent via hPB.toPackageATimed.

theorems.name: theft_during_era_of_erasure
theorems.conclusion: j * R ≤ r ∧ r < (j + 1) * R
theorems.notes: Depends on no axioms.

theorems.name: theft_is_recent
hypotheses: h : theftSched n (fun t => t / R) (stolenOf stolenAt) s
theorems.conclusion: ∃ j r, s / R ≤ j ∧ stolenAt (producerForSlot n s) j r ∧ s < r + R
theorems.notes: Backward theft-locality. Proof: unpack theftSched to ⟨j, hj : s/R ≤ j, r, hr⟩; hA3 gives j*R ≤ r; Nat.div_add_mod s R + Nat.mod_lt + Nat.mul_le_mul_left R hj; omega. Requires the schedule to be syntactically fun t => t / R (theftSched at that lambda); Nat.mul_comm needed to align R*j vs j*R.

theorems.name: exposedSched_subset_recentTheft
theorems.conclusion: exposedProducersSched n (fun s => s / R) (stolenOf stolenAt) u ⊆ recentTheftProducers n R stolenAt u
theorems.notes: Bridge from the timeless exposure census (KeyStealingScheduleBudget) to the timed census. Proof: Finset.mem_image unpacks exposure to a slot s ∈ Ico u (u+n) with theftSched; theft_is_recent gives j r; membership in range n via producerForSlot = s % n < n (needs hn); u/R ≤ s/R by Nat.div_le_div_right (u ≤ s); u < r + R by omega from s < r + R and u ≤ s.

theorems.name: horizon_budget_of_timed
hypotheses: hRent : ∀ u, H ≤ u → (badSlotsIn rented u n).card ≤ Rrent
hTheft : ∀ u, H ≤ u → (recentTheftProducers n R stolenAt u).card ≤ T
theorems.conclusion: ByzantineBoundedFrom H n (badSched n (fun s => s / R) rented (stolenOf stolenAt))
theorems.notes: THE TIMED I3 — the step a mode-1 / mode-3 analogue must mirror. Exact derivation: (1) intro u hu; (2) hsplit := badSlotsIn_union_le rented (theftSched n (fun s => s / R) (stolenOf stolenAt)) u n — card of the OR-predicate window ≤ card rented-window + card theft-window (KeyStealingBudget.lean:52); (3) htheft := theftSlotsSched_card_le_exposed n (fun s => s / R) (stolenOf stolenAt) u — theft slots per window ≤ exposed producers (producer↔slot injection, KeyStealingScheduleBudget.lean:148); (4) hsub := exposedSched_subset_recentTheft hn hR hA3 (stolenAt := stolenAt) u, hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub; (5) hrw : badSlotsIn (badSched …) u n).card = (badSlotsIn (fun s => rented s ∨ theftSched …) u n).card := rfl — badSched unfolds definitionally to the disjunction (badSched_iff_or is Iff.rfl); rw [hrw]; (6) calc … ≤ rent + theft (hsplit) ≤ Rrent + T (Nat.add_le_add (hRent u hu) (le_trans htheft (le_trans hcard (hTheft u hu)))) ≤ maxByzantine n (hRT). Mirrors induced_byzantine_bounded_sched (KeyStealingScheduleBudget.lean:164) with the H-guard threaded and the census swapped.

modules.purpose: Mode-1 σ-localized horizon core (the Δconf-conf localisation): runs the pigeonhole at the top window [σ-n, σ) matured in both chains by a coexistence block at slot σ, so confirmed-prefix membership agreement needs only n ≤ Δconf (not 2n) and no shared genesis. Re-proves honest-slot uniqueness for badKeyrotOn on this route (honestSlotsUnique_keyrot_horizon, global budget) and the ANCHORED form (honestSlotsUnique_keyrot_anchored) where the budget is consulted only on windows ending after an anchor block A shared by both chains.

defs.name: exists_honest_shared_slot_at
defs.signature: private theorem exists_honest_shared_slot_at {n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {bad : ByzantineSlots} {u : Nat} (hBudgetU : (badSlotsIn bad u n).card ≤ maxByzantine n) {S S' : Finset Nat} (hS : S ⊆ Finset.Ico u (u + n)) (hS' : S' ⊆ Finset.Ico u (u + n)) (hCard : quorum n ≤ S.card) (hCard' : quorum n ≤ S'.card) : ∃ s, s ∈ S ∧ s ∈ S' ∧ ¬ bad s
defs.meaning: Identical private copy of the single-window pigeonhole (see ScheduleHorizon:86). Not importable.

theorems.name: sigma_shared_prefix
hypotheses: hBudgetU : (badSlotsIn bad (σ - n) n).card ≤ maxByzantine n
hHonestLt : ∀ τ, τ < σ → ¬ bad τ → ∀ ⦃B B' : Block⦄, B ∈ record τ → B' ∈ record τ → B = B'
hb : blockAt? c k = some b
theorems.conclusion: blockAt? c' k = some b
theorems.notes: Budget at the single window [σ-n, σ); honest-slot uniqueness only strictly below σ (the shared slot s < σ from the window bound). k ≤ k₁ via strictSlots_lt contradiction (b.slot ≤ s). same_block_same_prefix then yields the block at k in c'.

theorems.name: confirmed_mem_iff_horizon
hypotheses: hBudgetU : (badSlotsIn bad (σ - n) n).card ≤ maxByzantine n
hHonestLt : ∀ τ, τ < σ → ¬ bad τ → ∀ ⦃B B' : Block⦄, B ∈ record τ → B' ∈ record τ → B = B'

theorems.notes: Replaces confirmed_mem_iff_le (KeyStealingSafety.lean:252, which needs hΔ : 2 * n ≤ Δconf, hBudget : ByzantineBounded n bad (global), and hGenesis : CommonPrefixUpTo c c' 0). Both directions by sigma_shared_prefix with chains swapped.

Strong induction on slot s (Nat.strongRecOn); the cross step reconciles inForce of sc' to sc via inForce_agreement_of_confirmed_eq + confirmed_mem_iff_horizon hn hΔ (hBudget _) hId hVc' hVc hRec' hRec hYc' hYs hXc hXs IH b hbconf (note chains passed in swapped order, IH is the hHonestLt), then hUnf.verified_was_signed on both chains. Replaces honestSlotsUnique_keyrot (KeyStealingUnique.lean:201: hΔ : 2 * n ≤ Δconf plus hGenesis : CommonPrefixUpTo (stripSigs sc) (stripSigs sc') 0).

hypotheses: hUnf : VersionedUnforgeable n Δconf ops registry rented Stolen honestSigned now Δ
hBudgetFrom : ∀ u, A.slot + 1 ≤ u + n → (badSlotsIn (badKeyrotOn n Δconf rented Stolen (stripSigs sc)) u n).card ≤ maxByzantine n

theorems.notes: MODE-1 ANCHORED BUDGET: the budget shape is `∀ u, A.slot + 1 ≤ u + n → …` (windows ENDING after the anchor slot), not ByzantineBoundedFrom. Proof: anchor at the same index kA in both chains (SequentialHeights), hPrefix := same_block_same_prefix from kA gives identical lists at heights ≤ kA; for s < A.slot + 1 the cross case uses hPrefix (no budget, no crypto); for s ≥ A.slot + 1 the horizon cross argument with budget at window (s - n) via hBudgetFrom (s - n) (by omega). Anchor of arbitrary age; A := genesis recovers the global form.
